source_refs.note: Exercise 14.2, Question 10: work done by two constant forces (book p.275; printed 'is displacement from'). Answer 32 Nm agrees with the key (PDF 312).

blocks.prompt: 10. A particle, acted by constant forces \(\underline{F}_1 = 3\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\) and \(\underline{F}_2 = \underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - \underline{k}\), is displacement from \(A(2, 1, 3)\) to \(B(5, 4, 4)\). Find the work done.
blocks.explanation:
Yahan ek particle par do constant forces ek saath lag rahi hain. Do forces mil kar ek resultant force ki tarah kaam karti hain.
Diya kya hai? \(\underline{F}_1\), \(\underline{F}_2\) aur do points \(A\), \(B\).
Find kya karna hai? Kul work.
Plan: forces jama karein, displacement \(\underline{AB}\) nikalein, phir dot product.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{F}_1 = 3\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{F}_2 = \underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - \underline{k}\); particle \(A(2, 1, 3)\) se \(B(5, 4, 4)\) tak jata hai.
Humein find karna hai: kul work done.
Tareeqa: Constant force ka work done \(W = \underline{F}\cdot\underline{d}\) hai (14.2.8). Work sirf force ke us hisse se hota hai jo harkat ki simt mein ho, yani \(|\underline{F}|\cos\theta\), aur use faasle se multiply karte hain: \(|\underline{F}|\cos\theta \times |\underline{d}| = \underline{F}\cdot\underline{d}\). Is liye work bas force aur displacement ka dot product hai. \(\underline{d}\) shuru wale point se aakhri point tak ka vector hai (head minus tail). Do forces hon to pehle un ka resultant \(\underline{F} = \underline{F}_1 + \underline{F}_2\) lete hain, jaise kitab ki Example 14 mein.

Resultant force
\[\underline{F} = (3 + 1)\underline{i} + (4 + 4)\underline{j} + (-3 - 1)\underline{k}\]
\[= 4\underline{i} + 8\underline{j} - 4\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Ek saath lagne wali forces vectors ki tarah jama hoti hain: \(\underline{i}\) wale \(\underline{i}\) se, \(\underline{j}\) wale \(\underline{j}\) se, \(\underline{k}\) wale \(\underline{k}\) se.

Displacement
\[\underline{d} = \underline{AB} = (5 - 2)\underline{i} + (4 - 1)\underline{j} + (4 - 3)\underline{k}\]
\[= 3\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + \underline{k}\]
Kyun: Displacement 'aakhri point minus pehla point' hota hai, component by component. Ulta minus karein to har sign ulat jayega aur work ka sign bhi ghalat aayega.
Dhyan dein: Minus ka minus plus: \(5 - (-3) = 8\).

Work done
\[W = (4)(3) + (8)(3) + (-4)(1)\]
\[= 12 + 24 - 4 = 32\]
Kyun: \(W = \underline{F}\cdot\underline{d}\): matching components multiply kar ke jama kiye. Work ek scalar hai (sirf number, koi simt nahi), is liye jawab mein \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\), \(\underline{k}\) nahi aate. Force newton mein aur faasla metre mein ho to work ki unit Nm (joule) hoti hai.

Tasdeeq: har force ka work alag
\[\underline{F}_1\cdot\underline{d} = 9 + 12 - 3 = 18\]
\[\underline{F}_2\cdot\underline{d} = 3 + 12 - 1 = 14\]
\[18 + 14 = 32 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dot product distributive hai: \((\underline{F}_1 + \underline{F}_2)\cdot\underline{d} = \underline{F}_1\cdot\underline{d} + \underline{F}_2\cdot\underline{d}\). Is liye pehle forces jama karein ya pehle alag alag work nikal kar jama karein, jawab ek hi aata hai. Dono tareeqon se 32 aaya.
Dhyan dein: Sirf ek force ka work likh dena adhoora jawab hai; sawal kul work maangta hai.
